Scan a folder

Source: R/map_folder.R
scan_folder.Rd

Walks the folder recursively and returns one row per file and folder. This is the data map_folder() draws its graph from.

Usage

scan_folder(
  path = ".",
  ignore = folder_ignore(),
  max_depth = 60,
  gitignore = FALSE
)

Arguments

path

The folder to scan.

ignore

Names to skip, see folder_ignore().

max_depth

How deep to go at most. Guards against loops through junctions on Windows.

gitignore

Also skip what git ignores in this folder? The question is put to git itself, so nested .gitignore files, negations and your global excludes all count. Off by default: the data and output folders a project keeps out of git are often exactly what you want on the map.

Value

A data frame with the columns path (relative, with /), size (bytes, 0 for folders), mtime (POSIXct) and dir (logical).

Examples

scan_folder(R.home("doc"))
